facts: The Sporting Legends Jackpot Ticker Specification identifies Daily as sljp-1, Weekly as sljp-2 and Mega as sljp-3.
Its example Daily response is game-based info=1, global local=0, includes timestamp and winc on gamedata, and guaranteedHitTime on the amount element.
The document explicitly says its Playtech casino name and ticker URL are examples and licensees must use their own relevant instance names and ticker URLs.
The mirrored document describes both JavaScript and XML Playtech progressive jackpot tickers.
For a JavaScript game-based ticker, info=1 selects game-based data and casino plus game are mandatory.
The JavaScript ticker parameter set documents local, currency and optional instanceCode in addition to casino and game.

The XML section independently defines game-based info=1, local=0 as global, currency as ISO 4217, gamedata timestamp as Unix UTC seconds, winc as win count, and guaranteedHitTime on amount as a Unix timestamp.
The document's non-XML error table distinguishes non-XML ticker info values, supporting that JavaScript ticker parameter semantics are service-level rather than an XML-only convention.
The public Playtech-platform configuration exposes useServicesCasinoJackpots=true.
It exposes both jackpotsCasinoUrl and liveEndpointUrl as https://webtickers.malmegas.com/webtickers.
sources.transferGuard: This proves a modern Playtech-platform webtickers architecture exists at another operator. It does not prove Betfair Spain uses the same casino name, endpoint, route, transport, request body or response schema.

scientificConsequence: A Betfair Spain HAR that co-locates the exact Betfair initialResources casino and configured webtickers endpoint, and then observes a game-based request carrying info=1, the exact casino, game=sljp-1, EUR and local=0, would have provider-documented parameter semantics rather than guessed field names. The HAR must still prove Betfair-specific transport, exact request placement and row-coherent response semantics before any modern webtickers snapshot can feed the overdue gate.
